# Cut › Match Cut

**What belongs here.** A and B share a form, motion, colour or composition, so the eye carries across.

**Examples.** circle → moon, door slam → gavel

**Family test.** Step through frame by frame: does any frame mix A and B? If not, it is a Cut.

Each transition here has its own folder named by its id (lowercase, hyphens). See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../../../CONTRIBUTING.md).

## Transitions

| Transition | Summary |
|---|---|
| [Anchored Match Cut](match-cut-anchor/) | A hard cut that lines up a point in the next scene with a point in the old one, then eases the new scene back to its own framing. |
